integrity: Mathematical claims were checked by complete deterministic state-space enumeration, independent support and SCC algorithms, and a separate all-order constructive proof. Literature priority is assessed from accessible primary text and remains nonexhaustive. No external audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The sharp finite census applies only to connected simple undirected graphs of orders 2 through 5 under synchronous binary majority with fresh independent fair ties; the infinite extension is constructive only. The model excludes isolated vertices and offers no general larger-network classification.
title: The five-vertex onset and complete minimal classification of persistent randomness in majority opinion diffusion
